posts.title: Today is February First
posts.description: So, it's already February. Time has been weird lately. Speeding by, but also going at a snail's pace. Since the second half of last year, I've felt an odd duality in our time, likely because it was the most challenging year of my life, yet also included several of the most rewarding moments. posts.title: What do you do when you have nothing
posts.description: Sometimes you have it; Sometimes you don't. You realized yesterday that you wouldn't have it today. You are tired and at a loss for words. Work has taken up a lot of your creative time lately. Which is unfortunate. Eventually you'll get past this. You always do. Kind of your thing. You get heads down and power through when necessary.
